# Tobias Gatti

> Tobias Gatti (also written Tobías Gatti; GitHub: tobiasgatti02) is a product engineer working across full stack and applied AI. At Firmaway (Nov 2024 - present) he built the Firmaway Capital release end to end and an internal RAG knowledge assistant with hybrid retrieval, verifiable citations and human-reviewed evals. He builds with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, and also designs and develops websites for studios and brands. He is open to remote engineering roles. Languages: Spanish (native), English (professional), German (B1).

## Projects

- [F4brica](https://f4brica.app): virtual studio for architecture firms: projects, deliverables, interactive 3D models and client feedback in one place
- [Tolio](https://tolio.app): peer-to-peer sharing-economy marketplace with identity verification (face recognition), real-time WebSocket chat and Stripe escrow payments
- Firmaway Knowledge Assistant (internal): RAG over product docs and PDFs with BM25 + embeddings, rank fusion, vision-based parsing, required citations and an evals console
- [Monitor Legal](https://github.com/tobiasgatti02/monitor-legal): daily dashboard for Argentine law firms with PJN automation
- [Web design work](https://www.tobiasgatti.com/webs/en): conceptual websites designed and built for architecture and photography studios (Estudio Aqua, Estudio Soler, Jut)

## Education

- Universidad Nacional del Sur (Argentina): software/systems engineering degree
- University of Graz / Universität Graz (Austria, 2026): Machine Learning Economics specialization

## Skills

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, tRPC, Stripe, WebSockets, REST APIs, Docker, AWS, LLM integration, RAG, LLM evaluation, Three.js, Cloudflare Workers AI, web design, product discovery.
